description: Change SignedIdentity, Session, Runtime, Chat, WidgetLive, and application wiring. Validate HS256 claims, scope, times, five-second first use; bind to Phoenix verified root socket.id via Mnesia before protected host work, subscriptions, or history. Reconnect same page using valid binding and new process-bound session; reject other-page replay. Preserve runtime-generation and ownership checks. Add focused tests.

comments.text: Connected integrated LiveView mounts now read identity_token from LiveView connect params, bind HS256 JWT to verified root socket.id before Chat.open host init/subscription, and fail closed on missing proof. SignedIdentity uses clustered BindingStore; process-local ReplayGuard removed. Session authorization rechecks binding/revocation. Existing postMessage init remains temporarily for migration and phase ww-v4a.5; signed conversation metadata removal is tracked in ww-v4a.6. mix test: 160 tests, 0 failures after mix assets.build. Real distributed store checks passed under ww-v4a.2.

title: Validate lightweight JWT and authenticate at connected LiveView mount
